---
title: "Threshold curve editor"
subtitle: ""
date: last-modified
inline: false
---

A prototype where you sketch the whole risk profile as a curve rather than typing numbers. Drag the red extinction-probability handles or the pink population handles across the timeline, and set each checkpoint year with the dials above the graph.

It runs entirely in your browser. [Open the app full-screen in a new tab &#8599;](hazard-app.html){target="_blank"}

<!-- HAZARD-APP:START -->
```{=html}
<div class="app-frame-wrap" style="overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;">
<iframe class="app-frame" src="apps/hazard.html" title="Threshold curve editor" loading="lazy" style="display:block;width:100%;border:0;height:1100px;min-width:800px;"></iframe>
</div>
<script>
/* Fit each app frame to its page: the app posts {appHeight} whenever its height changes. */
if (!window.appFrameFit) {
  window.appFrameFit = true;
  window.addEventListener('message', function (e) {
    if (!e.data || typeof e.data.appHeight !== 'number') return;
    document.querySelectorAll('iframe.app-frame').forEach(function (f) {
      if (f.contentWindow === e.source) f.style.height = Math.ceil(e.data.appHeight) + 'px';
    });
  });
}
</script>
```
<!-- HAZARD-APP:END -->

This prototype is also discussed, alongside the digit-based one, in [Website for demonstrating existential risk](201.qmd).
